Child safety

Children take part through adults we can account for.

AfroBot is a kids-only program. The public site is not a place for children’s profiles, and a mentor does not work with students until screening is done.

Content pending. A formal child-safety policy is still in review. The rules below are how the program is meant to operate.

Who submits information

A parent or guardian submits interest for a student. If you are under 18, ask an adult to use the form. Do not send a full date of birth, a school ID, or a photo of a child through the form.

No public child profile

AfroBot does not publish a page, ranking, or portfolio for a child. Photographs already on this site are from a 2024 community day and do not name the children in them.

Mentors and volunteers

Screening is required before a person mentors, coaches, or volunteers with students. Sending the interest form starts a conversation. It is not an approval, and it does not authorize contact with a child.

Concerns

Email info@afrobot.org with the subject “Child safety”. Write what happened, when, and how to reach you. Do not include a child’s unnecessary personal details.
